description:
You are a probation officer conducting your monthly caseload review. The Complaints module in ArkCase contains 7 active cases representing supervisees currently on supervised release. Three of these supervisees are non-compliant: they have missed their mandatory 30-day check-in, as indicated by 'Last Contact' dates in their case details that are more than 90 days in the past (before December 1, 2025). Four supervisees are compliant.

For each non-compliant supervisee case you identify, take the following three actions:
1. Change the case Priority to 'High'
2. Add a case note containing exactly this text: 'NON-COMPLIANCE FLAGGED: Supervisee has failed to appear for mandatory monthly contact. Case escalated per Policy CPO-7.3b. Supervisor notification required.'
3. Create a task titled 'Schedule immediate office report' assigned to arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com

Do not modify the compliant cases. Only modify cases where the Last Contact date is before December 1, 2025.

Login: arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com / ArkCase1234!
